findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed a small layer of mold to be present in ice machine. Discussed with PIC, ice machine will be emptied and cleaned. Ensure ice machine is being cleaned at a frequency that prevents any mold accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed multiple food items to be stored on floor in dry storage walk in cooler. Discussed with PIC, items on floor were moved to at least 6 inches off of ground. Ensure any food item is stored at least 6 inches off of ground to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Observed the following physical facility repairs to be needed:

RESTROOMS: Recaulk handsinks to the wall in both. 

KITCHEN
Recaulk handwashing sink to the wall. 
Seal bottom edge of nudo to the wall (near handsink and mop sink). 
Caulk holes in the walls. 
Paint/seal bare wood shelves and mop sink mounting. 
Add seal to bottom edge of back door-- daylight visible when closed. 
Replace acoustic ceiling tiles over the dish area with vinyl/smooth & easily cleanable.
Fix leak from 3 compartment sink faucet.

Discussed with PIC, repairs are going to be completed. Ensure physical facility is being repaired.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
